kept.heading: YOUTUBE CULTURE & TRENDS REPORT: HOW TECHNOLOGY IS CHANGING PERSONAL EXPRESSION (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: AI is becoming a tool for personal expression rather than just content production. 72% of video posters aged 14-44 have used AI to create or edit images or videos, and 61% are interested in using AI to insert themselves into content. Creators use AI to restore childhood memories, and hobbyists turn fashion sketches into realistic designs and bring fan fiction to life.

kept.heading: HOW GEN Z IS CHANGING PACKAGING (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Brands are moving from safe, minimal packaging toward designs Gen Z wants to display and collect, since the package stays visible in content long after purchase. Mane wraps heat protectants and smoothing products in consistent pink packaging that makes the whole line recognizable before anyone reads a label. Touchland keeps its sanitizer format fixed while rotating limited character collaborations, and Reale Actives pairs playful names like Go Calm with clear descriptions of what each product does.

kept.heading: WIN REPORT: HOW A SIMPLER HOMEPAGE INCREASED SALES BY 24% (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: The Raw Honey Shop increased sales by 24% by simplifying its homepage and making key selling points easier to find. The original page buried product information and trust signals in lengthy brand storytelling, and 50% of desktop visitors never reached the products section. The redesign replaced long paragraphs with a scannable checklist of product benefits, connected a beekeeper's photo to a specific trust claim, and added a “Shop our honeys” button near the top of the page. The test shows how clear value propositions and prominent calls to action can help visitors make purchase decisions with less effort.

kept.heading: HOW TO CREATE LINKS FOR SEO GOOGLE CAN'T IGNORE (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Build links from topically relevant sites rather than chasing volume. Place links high in article text with descriptive surrounding context and natural anchors that reflect each page's unique purpose. Earn independent editorial links that add new information instead of relying on sitewide links or mass syndication. Space link-building efforts over time and keep the source page, anchor text, surrounding content, and destination closely aligned. Avoid redirects or content changes that weaken a page's topical relevance.

kept.heading: WE TESTED MICROSOFT CLARITY TO UNDERSTAND BOT TRAFFIC AND CITATIONS (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Microsoft Clarity adds useful AI visibility data to your marketing measurement stack by tracking bot activity, AI citations, and website usability issues. Brainlabs found that AI bots generated 27,190 requests between September 1 and September 28, representing 13.15% of measured traffic, but crawling activity did not necessarily translate into referral visits. Its Topic Insights feature also found gaps in citations for nonbranded prompts related to AI search measurement and agentic enablement. Session recordings can connect technical errors and user behavior to specific problems, such as a failing form that prevented clients from submitting feedback. The tool is free, but its AI visibility features are in beta and require carefully chosen prompts, relevant integrations, and validation against other analytics data.

kept.heading: SHOULD YOU HARD-CODE YOUR WEBSITE AND RUN IT FROM GITHUB? (WEBINAR)
kept.blurb: Vector's VP of Marketing Jess Cook and ércule founder Justin Dunham share what they learned from moving a live website to GitHub. They'll explain why Vector left its CMS and how the team managed the migration alongside a rebrand. The webinar covers launch challenges and lessons from the first 30 days.

kept.heading: IS EMAIL MARKETING DEAD? NO, BUT EVERYTHING HAS CHANGED (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Email marketing still builds valuable audience relationships, even as open and click rates become less reliable measures of performance. Apple's Mail Privacy Protection inflates opens, while AI summaries can answer subscribers' questions without a click, making email's influence harder to track. Treat your email list as an audience to nurture rather than a pipeline of customers to convert, especially since roughly 95% of the B2B market is out of market at any given time. Measure performance across quarters using branded search, retention, replies, referrals, leads, and sales instead of relying on opens and clicks.

kept.heading: THE FORM BEFORE THE ANSWER: HOW CHATGPT QUESTIONS BUYERS BEFORE RECOMMENDING ANYTHING (8 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: 79.4% of buying prompts trigger a follow-up questionnaire before recommendations. Most forms arrive pre-filled, with 89.7% of budget questions defaulting to the middle price range. Brands can use these forms to identify the criteria ChatGPT uses to narrow choices. Track them across repeated prompts and markets, then align product content with those criteria and ensure current prices and purchase links are easy for AI to retrieve.

kept.heading: HOW HARVEY IS BUILDING A FRONTIER MARKETING ORG (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Harvey's marketing team used agents to make a tailored product film for each of hundreds of target accounts.

kept.heading: 3 NEW STUDIES SUGGEST AI VISIBILITY & SEARCH NOT WORTH INVESTING IN (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: ChatGPT drove just 0.62% of Google organic's traffic across 145 million sessions, organic beat all AI assistants 39x in a second study, and a third found no AI lift in branded search.

kept.heading: GOOGLE SEARCH RANKING VOLATILITY GETS HEADED OCTOBER 24TH (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google Search rankings showed significant volatility on October 24, suggesting an unconfirmed update that began Friday and continued into Saturday. SEO tracking tools recorded movement while site owners reported traffic drops and unstable rankings. Some also described declining Google Discover traffic and outdated news results. This follows several bouts of volatility earlier in October and the September spam update, which ran from September 24 to October 8.

kept.heading: PENNSYLVANIA SIGNS AI DECEPTIVE ADVERTISING ACT. WHAT IT MEANS FOR BRANDS (4 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Pennsylvania's AI Deceptive Advertising Act requires brands to disclose AI-generated content when it creates a false impression about a product or service. Disclosures must appear at the first point of consumer exposure, and the law applies to businesses of all sizes. Since it remains unclear what qualifies as a false impression, brands can reduce legal risk by disclosing AI use more broadly. California and New York are also pursuing their own rules for synthetic advertising.

kept.heading: EVERY STORY NEEDS A VILLAIN. SO DOES YOUR BRAND (6 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Build your brand around one clear enemy that customers already recognize. Dollar Shave Club challenged overpriced razors, while Snickers built years of ads around hunger with its “You're not you when you're hungry” campaign. Patagonia fights throwaway culture through durable clothing and repair programs. Turn your brand's villain into a content strategy by showing how the problem affects customers and connecting it to the deeper belief your brand stands for.

kept.heading: 400,000 FOLLOWERS OR 40 REGULARS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: IRL influencers build influence by bringing people together repeatedly, not just attracting online followers. LA Chess Club grew its free weekly chess nights to hundreds of attendees who returned for the connections. With 51% of Gen Z feeling lonely on weekends and 62% wishing online friendships led to more in-person plans, look beyond reach and impressions. Someone who brings 40 people back every week may have more meaningful influence than someone with 400K passive followers.

kept.heading: SUBMIT A URL TO BRAVE SEARCH (WEBSITE)
kept.blurb: You can submit website URLs to be re-fetched by Brave Search, which can help with GEO. Claude's web search is powered by the Brave Search API.

kept.heading: OPTIMIZED TAGGING EXPERIENCE FOR GOOGLE TAG MANAGER (11 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Google Tag Manager's new tagging experience combines Google Tag and GTM into one system, reducing page load overhead by loading destinations through a single container. It also centralizes settings and consent controls for Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Floodlight. Before migrating, audit existing settings and permissions to prevent data quality or compliance issues. Test changes in Preview mode and migrate destinations incrementally if settings conflict.

kept.heading: YOUR MARKETING TEAM WILL BE ON GITHUB WITHIN A YEAR (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Once a team shares more than a handful of AI skills and source files, Drive and Claude Projects stop working as their home. The files depend on each other, so teams need a change history to trace off-brand output, one-step rollback, and plain files any AI tool can read. A content team at a B2B SaaS company built that on GitHub without developer support, where every member's Claude reads the same positioning and voice files and a newly pushed skill reaches the whole team at once.

kept.heading: GIVE THE MACHINE A MANDATE BEFORE YOU GIVE IT A BUDGET (7 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Knight Capital lost $460M in 45 minutes, and Zillow lost $304M after automated systems made costly decisions without adequate controls. Ad platforms pose similar risks when algorithms control spending without clear limits. Before launching automated campaigns, define what the system can buy and which decisions require approval. Set spending caps for brand searches and existing customers. Use independent holdout tests to measure results and set clear criteria for pausing campaigns.

kept.heading: NETFLIX: YOUTUBE PULLS AWAY (5 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Americans now spend nearly twice as much time watching YouTube as Netflix on their TVs (not including YouTube TV).

kept.heading: UPDATED GOOGLE PRIVACY POLICY SAYS YOUR GMAIL MIGHT BE USED FOR ADVERTISING (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: A recent privacy policy update lets Search use connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos content to personalize ads.

kept.heading: STARTUPS DON'T NEED TO GO VIRAL TO WIN CUSTOMERS (3 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Phone outreach and in-person events still reach a large offline client base that viral content misses.
